target_customer: Hong Kong property owners, hospitals, government and households buying air purification and HVAC energy savings
problem: Indoor air carries viruses and bacteria, and air handling units waste energy. Aurabeat sells silver ion antiviral filters and a sonic HVAC retrofit.
business_model: Hardware sales (purifiers, filters, EcoSonic retrofit) to businesses and consumers
product_category: Air purification and HVAC energy efficiency hardware

founders.name: Phil Yuen
previous_startups: TextPayMe (acquired by Amazon and folded into Amazon Payments, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was in the YC 06 batch.

founders.name: Roger Sze To
founders.background_notes: YC page: 15+ years of research in building energy and indoor environmental quality, credited with three technologies.

competitors.name: Molekule
competitors.what: Premium consumer air purifier using PECO, tested on viruses

technical_complexity.rationale: Hardware design, independent lab testing and certifications (EPA, FDA registration per YC page) are demanding but based on known filtration and silver ion techniques.

defensibility.rationale: Certifications and lab results help credibility and tender wins, but purifier markets are crowded and every maker ran Covid tests, per a March 2021 New York Magazine summary.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying evidence found.

market_need_then: Covid created demand for antiviral air treatment in 2020 and 2021; SCMP coverage described its lab test claim of eliminating 99.9 percent of the virus (headline), and HKTDC reports it won a government tender and public hospital use.

identity.visual_style: Certification and awards led corporate site
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, sustainability focused, short punchy claims and award listing (company site).

branding.brand_signature: Silver ion AG+ and EcoSonic product names, award badges
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by SCMP, The Standard and HKTDC; Gaw Capital donated 300 units to elder homes in Feb 2022. No fan or meme evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Local credibility in Hong Kong through press, government and landlord partners (Gaw Capital, Swire logos on site), but no international brand pull.

pivots.to: Added EcoSonic HVAC energy saving and IoT filtration
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from the product mix on the company site, no dated source

outcome_analysis: Aurabeat became a profitable Hong Kong air treatment company by its own site, selling to hospitals, landlords and government, and added EcoSonic HVAC retrofits after the Covid peak. Covid demand and certifications drove early sales; funding is thinly documented, and the Covid tailwind faded, so later growth depends on the energy saving product.
notes: Funding: CB Insights alone reports about $1.5M over 3 rounds with a $1M seed on 2021-05-03 (TMT Investments, YC, SV Pacific Ventures); single aggregator, so it is not recorded as a round. A Chinese article reportedly mentions Swire investment, which was not found in other sources. Education and prior employers for founders not found. Pivot date unknown.
